newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Samper names new Transport Minister.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Samper names new Transport Minister.

text.p: President Ernesto Samper named his third Transportation minister in less than a month on Friday, making the post one of the fastest-moving in Colombia's cabinet.

Sources in the Casa de Narino presidential palace said Samper had tapped 62-year-old Jorge Enrique Rizzo Pombo, a civil engineer and former mayor of the Caribbean port of Cartagena, to replace Hernando Monroy Valencia.

Monroy Valencia, like Rizzo a member of the opposition Conservative Party, was named Transportation minister on May 22. However, he never actually took office because of local media reports that he is a senior partner in a firm that has several outstanding road-building contracts with the Colombian government.

Monroy Valencia replaced Carlos Hernan Lopez, who stepped down on May 18 amid a scandal over alleged abuse of office. His resignation came after Attorney General Jaime Bernal Cuellar suspended him for three months pending an investigation into charges that he used the Transporatation Ministry to engage in partisan politics.
